t1.text: History: Log Entries and Thoughts in one list

n1.text:
Real titles: Severance (Apple TV+), Piranesi (Susanna Clarke), Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron, Kafka on the Shore (Haruki Murakami), Perfect Days.

Newest first. Log Entries keep their Log Order; a Thought sits by its date; an undated Log Entry stays last (Spirit).

A Thought copied from a Backlog Note is a plain Planned Thought: "while on your Watchlist". There is no 'copied' mark, since the model has none.

Tweaks switches every board between dark and light.

n2.text:
To pick: a Thought's row.

A: the same bordered list; a Thought has a small icon, the date line carries the state and the Progress, the text in full under it, a ⋯ menu as a Log Entry has.
B: a timeline; a dot per item (gold for a Log Entry), the state and Progress as chips, a "Write a thought…" box on top, the whole item taps to edit.
C: Log Entries stay today's rows; a Thought is a soft card inside the list, a quote on gold, the date line under the text.

n3.text:
The same in every variant:

"History" for every Media Type.
State labels: while on your Watchlist / Reading list, while watching / reading, after watching / reading; none when it is not in Saved.
Progress as the app writes it: "S2 · E5", "p. 142".
A quote in curly quotes and italics, never a left border.
The text is plain, kept in full (up to 2,000 characters) with its line breaks.

picks.text:
Picked 2026-11-16:
The row: A (one bordered list; a Thought's icon, the state and Progress on the date line, the text in full, a ⋯ menu).
The form: A (the Watched sheet's shape: Quote switch, the Progress row with Change and ×, date chips, Delete beside Save when editing).

n4.text:
To pick: the add and edit form.

A: the Watched sheet's shape: a header with the poster, the text, Quote as a switch row, the Progress as a row with Change and ×, date chips (Today, Yesterday, Other date), Save at the bottom, Delete beside it when editing.
B: write first: Cancel · title · Save on top, a tall text box, then one row of chips under it (Quote, the date, the Progress with ×).

Both: no autosave; the Progress filled in from In Progress; the counter from 1,800 characters; a dialog from md.
